issues.description: torch.cuda.set_device crashes when --local_rank not provided by launcher
issues.detail: args.local_rank defaults to None; deepspeed launches typically set LOCAL_RANK env var rather than passing --local_rank. torch.cuda.set_device(None) will raise TypeError before init_distributed. Read from env var or require the arg.

issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: docstring/usage diverge (max_step vs max_steps, missing val_interval)
issues.detail: The class docstring documents 'max_steps' and 'val_interval', but the code reads trainer_args['max_step'] and never reads val_interval (validation runs every save_interval inside run()). Configs written to the documented schema will KeyError; behavior diverges from docs.

issues.description: Checkpoint sort by int(step_X) breaks for names like 'step_100_tag' or non-numeric suffixes
issues.detail: Filter uses substring match '"step_" in d.name', but the sort key does int(x.name.split('step_')[-1]). Any directory with a non-integer suffix (e.g., 'step_100_best') passes the filter and crashes sort. Use a stricter regex and skip non-matching entries.

issues.description: Validation all_stats lists hold per-rank averaged scalars but lengths can diverge across ranks
issues.detail: Each rank iterates its own DistributedSampler shard; if shard sizes differ, the post-loop mean is computed over different N per rank, producing inconsistent logged values. Also, only rank 0 should call wandb.log; here every rank logs (but only rank 0's wandb is active, which is OK), yet averages still differ.

issues.description: _all_reduce_stats mutates dict during iteration and assumes identical keys/shapes across ranks
issues.detail: Iterating 'for key in stats' then reassigning stats[key] is safe in CPython but fragile. More importantly, all_reduce requires every rank to call with identical keys in the same order; if a rank's model returns different stat keys (e.g., task-specific losses on multi-task batches), this deadlocks silently.

issues.description: Run loop saves checkpoint every iteration even when no training step occurred, risking infinite loop
issues.detail: If train() returns without advancing global_step (e.g., empty iterator at end of data), the while loop saves a checkpoint at the same step forever. Add a guard that breaks when global_step does not advance, or align save cadence with actual progress.

review.summary: The PR introduces a DeepSpeed-based trainer and launcher for SpeechLM. The most pressing issues are environment-coupling bugs around --local_rank (will crash under standard deepspeed launchers) and a mismatch between documented trainer_args keys (max_steps/val_interval) and the keys actually read (max_step, no val_interval). Secondary concerns include fragile checkpoint sorting, all_reduce assumptions about identical stat keys across ranks, validation averaging across uneven shards, and a run loop that may save repeatedly when training does not advance. Worth resolving these before merge to avoid silent multi-GPU misbehavior.
